headline: Boticas Perú Owners Complete Acquisition of Bakery Chain Pastipan
summary: The controlling family behind Boticas Perú acquired 100% of bakery chain Pastipan following six months of negotiations. The deal was finalized after two prior acquisition attempts by other buyers failed.
why: Boticas Perú is a prominent retail chain operator in Peru; expanding into food service signals retail group diversification.

impacts.name: Boticas Peru
impacts.why: Owner of Boticas Perú secured full equity ownership of local bakery chain Pastipan.
